home.title: Home
home.subtitle: Current state of this node and the traffic it is serving.
home.attentionDeadNode: Node {{id}} has not sent a heartbeat in {{age}}.
home.attentionFailures: {{count}} failed requests in the selected window.

home.quickExplorerHint: Run any endpoint without leaving the console.

containers.title: Containers
containers.subtitle: Containers hold objects. Each maps to an S3 bucket and can carry its own tags.
containers.nameHelp: 3–63 characters: lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens, starting and ending with a letter or digit.
containers.nameInvalid: That name does not meet the container naming rules.
containers.nameTaken: A container with that name already exists.
containers.deleteConfirm: Delete container {{name}}? This cannot be undone.
containers.deleteNotEmpty: {{name}} still holds {{count}} object(s). Deleting it will delete them too.
containers.deleteTypeName: Type the container name to confirm
containers.emptyHint: Create one to start storing objects.

cache.enableHint: Keep frequently read objects in memory on each node to speed up reads.
cache.maxObjectsHint: The most objects to keep cached at once.
cache.maxMemoryHint: Memory ceiling for the cache. 0 means no cap.
cache.evictCountHint: How many objects to evict when the cache is full.
cache.maxObjectSizeHint: Objects larger than this are never cached. 0 means no ceiling.
cache.disabled: Caching is disabled for this container.
cache.validationMaxObjects: Max objects must be a positive whole number.
cache.validationEvictCount: Evict count must be a positive whole number.
cache.validationEvictTooLarge: Evict count cannot exceed max objects.
cache.validationMemory: Max memory must be zero or a positive whole number.
cache.validationObjectSize: Max cacheable object size must be zero or a positive whole number.

resp.label: RESP database index
resp.hint: A Redis client that issues SELECT n addresses the container claiming index n instead of the default resp{n}. The index is unique across all containers and must be within the node's Resp.DatabaseCount (16 by default) to be reachable. Choose None to leave this container unavailable over RESP.
resp.conflict: That index is already in use by another container.
resp.negative: The RESP database index must be zero or greater.

multipartExpiry.label: Multipart upload expiry (days)
multipartExpiry.hint: How long in-progress multipart uploads survive before the janitor reclaims them. Leave blank to inherit the system-wide default.
multipartExpiry.range: Must be a whole number of days from 1 to 365.

multipart.hint: Uploads that were started but never completed or aborted. They hold storage until they finish or expire.
multipart.abortConfirm: Abort the multipart upload for {{key}}? Any parts already uploaded are discarded.
multipart.partsHint: The parts already staged for this upload. Deleting one discards its data until it is re-uploaded.
multipart.partsEmpty: No parts have been uploaded yet.
multipart.deletePartConfirm: Delete part {{partNumber}}? Its data is discarded and completing the upload will fail until it is re-uploaded.

objects.title: Objects in {{container}}
objects.subtitle: Every object is an immutable extent: a binary payload plus labels, tags, and freeform JSON.
objects.keyHelp: Keys may contain any characters, including slashes.
objects.labelsPlaceholder: Add a label and press Enter
objects.noMetadataObject: This object has no metadata object.
objects.deleteConfirm: Delete object {{key}}? This cannot be undone.
objects.emptyHint: Upload an object to get started.
objects.editMetadataHint: Extents are immutable, so this rewrites the object with its existing payload.
objects.selectPromptHint: Choose a container above to browse and manage its objects.

uploads.title: Uploads
uploads.subtitle: In-progress multipart uploads that hold storage until they finish or expire.
uploads.selectPromptHint: Choose a container above to see its in-progress multipart uploads.

search.title: Search
search.subtitle: Find objects across every container by key, label, and tag.
search.guidance: Add a key prefix, one or more labels, or tag pairs, then run the search.

capacity.title: Capacity
capacity.subtitle: Where storage is going, and which nodes are serving it.
capacity.rehydrateHint: Reconciles the metadata database against raw extent storage. Verify reports drift; Repair fixes it; Rebuild reconstructs the database from storage.

requests.title: Request History
requests.subtitle: Every REST request this node served, with full request and response detail.
requests.truncated: Truncated: showing the first {{shown}} of {{total}} bytes.
requests.empty: No requests have been captured yet.
requests.disabled: Request capture is disabled on this node, so no history is retained.

observability.title: Observability
observability.subtitle: Metrics, traces, and logs for this deployment.
observability.intro: Telemetry is off by default. Bring it up with the docker compose stack, then open Grafana — the main entry point for dashboards, metrics, traces, and logs. The credentials below are the stack defaults; change them for anything beyond local use. See TELEMETRY.md for setup details.
observability.grafanaDesc: Dashboards, metrics, traces, and logs. The primary observability UI.
observability.tempoDesc: Distributed tracing backend. Query traces through Grafana rather than here.
observability.lokiDesc: Log aggregation backend. Query logs through Grafana rather than here.
observability.collectorDesc: OTLP ingest endpoint the nodes push telemetry to. Not a browsable UI.

explorer.title: API Explorer
explorer.subtitle: Run any endpoint on this node and inspect the exact response.
explorer.selectOperation: Select an operation to build a request.
explorer.specMissing: This node did not serve an OpenAPI document at /openapi.json, so the explorer cannot list operations.
explorer.destructiveConfirm: This is a destructive operation ({{method}} {{path}}). Run it?
explorer.invalidJson: The body is not valid JSON.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: How this node is configured and where each protocol is listening.
settings.protocolHint: Ports come from this node's configuration; the console reads the REST endpoint you connected to.
settings.rebootNote: Changes take effect after the node restarts.
settings.saved: Settings saved. Restart to apply them.
settings.restartHint: Exits the node so its container restarts on the saved settings. This needs a container restart policy — a bare process will simply stop.
settings.restartConfirm: Restart the node now? The console will lose its connection until the node comes back up.
settings.restarting: Restarting… the node will be briefly unavailable.
settings.fullConfigHint: Every setting in the node's configuration file. Changes take effect after a restart. This includes credentials — the node is unauthenticated.
settings.fullConfigSaved: Configuration saved. Restart to apply it.

setup.subtitle: This node has no containers yet. Here is the shortest path to storing something.
setup.step1Hint: Containers hold objects and map to S3 buckets.
setup.step2Hint: Attach labels, tags, and freeform JSON alongside the payload.
setup.step3Hint: Filter across containers by label and tag.
